versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes to code or functionality; only documentation/assets updated.

- Initial release of 域名检查服务 (Domain Check Service)
- Supports batch domain registration status checks with dual verification, based on Python and MCP protocol
- Enforces mandatory API key configuration; prompts user for key if missing
- Includes structured workflow: check API key, select tool based on user intent, extract parameters, invoke tool, and return result
- Provides one main tool function scripts.tools.check_domains for checking multiple domains
- Clear instructions to never fabricate data when API key is missing
